# Fields: its records

Generated from `src/modules/tags/types.ts` (every record, field and the comment written beside it). Fields' records (TG1), owned by the module: a workspace's field, and a goal's value for one. They live in the workspace under `modules.tags` (domain/records): `fields` and `fieldValues`, as records.ts declares them. Stored in goal_fields and goal_field_values (migration 0052), neither of which has removed_at: a field is retired, a value cleared. A field a workspace defines. A retired one keeps every value and can be brought back (Lane, 5a).

The module’s own records, not the core’s: the core keeps them without knowing what they are (`src/domain/records.ts`), filed in the workspace and in a save under `modules.tags`. How each is declared, as `module.json` lists it:

| Record | Table | Filed under | Removable |
|---|---|---|---|
| field | `goal_fields` | `modules.tags.fields` | no |
| field value | `goal_field_values` | `modules.tags.fieldValues` | no |

## GoalField

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes | 1 to 40 characters; no other live field has it, whatever the case. |
| `kind` | `'list' \| 'text'` | yes | A list of values (filterable from TG2), or free text. It doesn't change once the field is added. |
| `options` | `string[]` | yes | A list's values, in order (1 to 20, each 1 to 40 characters, none twice); a text field has none. |
| `position` | `number` | yes | Its place in the order goals' pages show the fields in. |
| `retiredAt` | `string \| null` | no | When it was retired; null or absent while it is live. |

## SavedField

A field as saved, with who added it and who retired it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `createdBy` | `string` | yes |  |
| `createdAt` | `string` | yes |  |
| `retiredBy` | `string \| null` | no |  |

## GoalFieldValue

A goal's value for one field. Its id is `{goalId}:{fieldId}` (migration 0052): a goal has one value per field.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `goalId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `fieldId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `value` | `string` | yes | As stored: a list's value as the list writes it, or free text of up to 80 characters. Empty when cleared. |
| `setBy` | `string` | yes | Who set it last, and when. |
| `setAt` | `string` | yes |  |
| `removedAt` | `string \| null` | no | Set only by the core's generic paths (a carried copy that leaves, a start undone): the value then reads as cleared, and is written so. |
| `removedBy` | `string \| null` | no |  |
